(f)	(7M-GE)
	Remove the throttle body brackets.

	Remove the air intake connector mounting bolts.

(i)	(7M-GE)
	Remove the air intake connector bracket mounting

	ting pipes and intake chamber with connector and
	gasket.
(n)	(7M-GTE)
	Disconnect the cold start injector connector.
